title: Jezero v1.0.1 Signed Data Pack Ready (708 Measured M20 Stops + Synthetic Placeholder Grid)
body: All static files are live in public_packs/jezero/v1/ (1.6 MB total): manifest.json (pack_version 1.0.1 with inputs[] SHA-256), waypoints.geojson (708 MEASURED Perseverance stops with rover_tilt_deg & panorama_url), route.geojson (MEASURED 45.2 km traverse + SIMULATED <=2km EVA corridor + 3 science stops on-route + 2 Sol 700/1578 benchmarks), hazard_grid.json (SIMULATED synthetic-v1 placeholder grid, grid_status=PLACEHOLDER, zero rover_tilt_deg leakage), hazard_overlay.png, and eva_constraints.json. Note: Mars Trek 25cm HiRISE tiles use a 2:1 geographic grid (EPSG:4326 style) which renders natively in Leaflet (L.CRS.EPSG4326), OpenLayers, or Cesium.
